info.title: CourtListener
info.description: CourtListener is a free legal research platform operated by Free Law Project. This connector provides access to federal and state court opinions, dockets, PACER filings, and citation verification.

get.description: Search federal court dockets by case name, docket number, court, or filing date. Use field selection to limit the response payload.

parameters.name: case_name
parameters.description: Filter dockets by case name (partial match).

parameters.name: docket_number
parameters.description: Filter dockets by docket number.

parameters.name: court
parameters.description: Filter dockets by court identifier (for example, scotus or ca9). Use court=xyz rather than court__id=xyz to avoid an expensive database join.

parameters.name: date_filed__gte
parameters.description: Filter dockets filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_filed__lte
parameters.description: Filter dockets filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Sort results by a field name, prefixed with a hyphen for descending order.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the next or previous URL in a prior response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response, reducing payload size and database load (for example, id,case_name,docket_number).

200.description: A paginated list of dockets matching the search criteria.

get.description: Retrieve a single court docket by its CourtListener numeric ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The CourtListener numeric ID of the docket to retrieve.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response, reducing payload size and database load (for example, id,case_name,docket_number).

200.description: The docket matching the specified ID.

get.description: List docket entries for a specific court docket, with optional filtering and sorting.

parameters.name: docket
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the docket (for example, 73382952). Use the ID field from a Get docket response, not the full resource URI.

parameters.name: entry_number
parameters.description: Filter by a specific docket entry number.

parameters.name: date_filed__gte
parameters.description: Filter entries filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_filed__lte
parameters.description: Filter entries filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Sort results by a field name, prefixed with a hyphen for descending order.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the next or previous URL in a prior response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response, reducing payload size and database load (for example, id,entry_number,description).

200.description: A paginated list of docket entries for the specified docket.

get.description: Search case law opinions by keyword, court, judge, or date using full-text search. Narrowing the query to a specific court or date range improves performance.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of content to search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query using CourtListener search operators.

parameters.name: court
parameters.description: Filter opinions by court identifier (for example, scotus or ca9). Use court=xyz rather than court__id=xyz to avoid an expensive database join.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sort results by a field, for example score desc or dateFiled desc.

parameters.name: filed_after
parameters.description: Filter opinions filed after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: filed_before
parameters.description: Filter opinions filed before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the next or previous URL in a prior response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response, reducing payload size and database load (for example, id,caseName,citation).

200.description: A paginated list of case law opinion search results.

post.description: Verify one or more legal citations, or extract all citations from a block of text.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The citation or block of text to look up.

count.description: The total number of dockets matching the query.

next.description: The URL to retrieve the next page of results.

previous.description: The URL to retrieve the previous page of results.

results.description: The list of dockets matching the query.

id.description: The CourtListener numeric ID of the docket.

resource_uri.description: The URI of this docket resource.

court_id.description: The identifier of the court (for example, scotus or ca9).

case_name.description: The short name of the case.

case_name_full.description: The full name of the case.

docket_number.description: The docket number assigned by the court.

date_filed.description: The date the case was filed.

date_terminated.description: The date the case was terminated, if applicable.

date_argued.description: The date the case was argued, if applicable.

assigned_to_str.description: The name of the judge assigned to this case.

referred_to_str.description: The name of the magistrate judge this case was referred to, if applicable.

nature_of_suit.description: The nature of suit code for this case.

jurisdiction_type.description: The type of jurisdiction for this case.

cause.description: The cause of action for this case.

jury_demand.description: Whether a jury was demanded in this case.

absolute_url.description: The relative URL path for this docket. Prepend https://www.courtlistener.com to construct the full link (for example, https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/73382952/case-name/).

pacer_case_id.description: The PACER case ID for this docket, if available.

source.description: The source code indicating how this docket was acquired.

blocked.description: Whether this docket is blocked from search engine indexing.

count.description: The total number of entries matching the query.

next.description: The URL to retrieve the next page of results.

previous.description: The URL to retrieve the previous page of results.

id.description: The CourtListener numeric ID of this docket entry.

docket.description: The URI of the parent docket for this entry.

date_filed.description: The date this entry was filed.

date_entered.description: The date this entry was entered into the docket.

entry_number.description: The sequential entry number on the docket.

description.description: The text description of this docket entry.

pacer_sequence_number.description: The PACER sequence number for this entry, if available.

count.description: The total number of opinions matching the query.

next.description: The URL to retrieve the next page of results.

previous.description: The URL to retrieve the previous page of results.

results.description: The list of opinion search results.

id.description: The CourtListener numeric ID of this opinion.

cluster_id.description: The ID of the opinion cluster this opinion belongs to.

docket_id.description: The ID of the docket associated with this opinion.

court_id.description: The identifier of the court that issued this opinion.

docketNumber.description: The docket number for this case.

dateFiled.description: The date this opinion was filed.

citation.description: The list of citations for this opinion.

status.description: The precedential status of this opinion.

citeCount.description: The number of times this opinion has been cited.

judge.description: The name of the judge who authored this opinion.

per_curiam.description: Whether this opinion was issued per curiam by the full court.

absolute_url.description: The relative URL path for this opinion. Prepend https://www.courtlistener.com to construct the full link (for example, https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/10863230/case-name/).

snippet.description: A text excerpt from the opinion relevant to the search query.

text.description: A block of legal text from which to extract and verify all citations.

volume.description: The volume number of the reporter for a single citation lookup.

reporter.description: The reporter abbreviation for a single citation lookup (for example, U.S. or F.3d).

page.description: The page number within the reporter volume for a single citation lookup.

citation.description: The citation that was looked up.

normalized_citations.description: Corrected citations if the input contained typos or non-canonical abbreviations.

start_index.description: The character position in the input text where this citation begins.

end_index.description: The character position in the input text where this citation ends.

status.description: The HTTP status code for this citation lookup result.

error_message.description: Details about any error encountered during the citation lookup.

clusters.description: The CourtListener cases matching this citation.

id.description: The CourtListener cluster ID for this case.

case_name.description: The name of the case matching this citation.

absolute_url.description: The relative URL path for this case. Prepend https://www.courtlistener.com to construct the full link (for example, https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/10863230/case-name/).
